    Keegan Bradley (born June 7, 1986) is a 39-year-old American professional golfer known for winning the 2011 PGA Championship in his major debut and for being named the 2025 U.S. Ryder Cup captain. As of April 2026, he is an active PGA Tour player with multiple wins, residing in Jupiter, FL. 
    This video shows a glimpse of Keegan Bradley's journey to becoming the U.S. Ryder Cup captain:
    1m
    PGA TOUR
    YouTube• Sep 23, 2025
    Key Details 
    • Age: 39 years old (born 1986).
    • Family: He is the nephew of LPGA Hall of Fame member Pat Bradley. He is married to Jillian Bradley (since 2016), and they have two sons, Logan and Cooper.
    • Career Highlights: Winner of the 2011 PGA Championship, 2024 BMW Championship, and 2025 Travelers Championship.
    • Ryder Cup: Named the U.S. Ryder Cup captain for 2025.
    • Style: Known as a passionate New England sports fan who frequently features in Netflix's Full Swing. 
    Recent Performance 
    • As of mid-April 2026, he is competing in the 2026 PGA Tour season, including competing at the RBC Heritage following the Masters.
    • He has earned over $56 million in his career.

    Keegan Hansen Bradley is an American professional golfer who competes on the PGA Tour. He has won eight tour events, most notably the 2011 PGA Championship. He is one of six golfers to win in his major debut, along with Ben Curtis, Fred Herd, Willie Park, Sr., Francis Ouimet and Horace Rawlins.
